igbo: Ahụ adịla m mma ugbu a.
Nwa ọhụrụ ahụ nwere ahụ ọkụ.
Ahụ onye ọrịa ahụ na-adị mma.
Onye ọrịa ahụ adịghị ike nke ukwuu.

english: We need to see a doctor.
She went to the hospital yesterday.
The doctor is examining the patient.
The doctor asked me some questions.

igbo: Nọọsụ nyere onye ọrịa ahụ aka.

english: I need to take my medicine.
igbo: Ọ dị m mkpa ịṅụ ọgwụ m.

english: Take this medicine twice a day.
igbo: Ṅụọ ọgwụ a ugboro abụọ kwa ụbọchị.
Ṅụọ ọgwụ ahụ mgbe i richara nri.

english: I bought medicine from the pharmacy.
igbo: Azụtara m ọgwụ n'ụlọ ahịa ọgwụ.
Ụlọ ahịa ọgwụ ahụ mepere emepe.

english: The doctor checked my blood pressure.

igbo: Ọ dị m mkpa ịga nyocha ahụike.

english: The doctor took a blood sample.

igbo: Ọ dị m mkpa izu ike.
Rie ọtụtụ mkpụrụ osisi na akwụkwọ nri.
Saa aka gị tupu ị rie nri.

english: Walking is good for your health.
igbo: Ije dị mma maka ahụike gị.

english: Regular exercise keeps the body healthy.
igbo: Mmega ahụ mgbe niile na-eme ka ahụ dị mma.

english: Healthy food gives the body strength.
igbo: Nri dị mma na-enye ahụ ike.

english: Too much sugar is not healthy.
igbo: Ọtụtụ shuga adịghị mma maka ahụike.

english: Too much salt is not healthy.
igbo: Ọtụtụ nnu adịghị mma maka ahụike.

english: He has a wound on his hand.
Be careful not to hurt yourself.
igbo: Kpachara anya ka ị ghara imerụ onwe gị ahụ.
Ọ dara wee merụọ onwe ya ahụ.
Olee mgbe ihe mgbu ahụ malitere?

english: How long have you been sick?
igbo: Ogologo oge ole ka ị na-arịa ọrịa?

english: The mother is taking care of the baby.
igbo: Nne ahụ na-elekọta nwa ọhụrụ ahụ.
Ụgbọ ala mberede ahụ rutere ngwa ngwa.

english: The hospital is far from here.
igbo: Ụlọ ọgwụ ahụ dị anya site ebe a.

english: The hospital is near my house.
igbo: Ụlọ ọgwụ ahụ dị nso n'ụlọ m.

english: The health centre is open today.
The doctor advised me to rest.
igbo: Dọkịta dụrụ m ọdụ ka m zuru ike.

english: The doctor advised him to drink more water.
igbo: Dọkịta dụrụ ya ọdụ ka ọ ṅụọ mmiri karịa.

english: The nurse gave the patient water.
igbo: Nọọsụ nyere onye ọrịa ahụ mmiri.
Onye ọrịa ahụ ṅụrụ ọgwụ ahụ.

english: The patient recovered from the illness.
igbo: Onye ọrịa ahụ gbakere n'ọrịa ahụ.

english: We must keep the environment clean.
igbo: Anyị ga-edebe gburugburu ebe obibi ọcha.
Gbasara ebe dị ọcha na-enyere aka igbochi ọrịa.
Na-arahụ ụra nke ọma kwa abalị.
